'''Labine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of a [[Unidentified desert cult|group]] of [[Desert/Legends|desert]]-worshiping cannibals. They held Labine her in a cave out in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], where she treated them for the [[laughing sickness]]. She encountered a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] and [[Corso Riggs]] when they came looking for a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Jettison]], who was being held by the cult.<ref name="TOR" />
